C124.name: Shinyanga Municipal Council
C124.documented: drought, strong winds, flash floods in heavy Vuli or Masika rain, and water shortage

area.en: Shinyanga Municipal: low-lying town and seasonal streams
area.sw: Manispaa ya Shinyanga: mji wa chini na vijito vya msimu

risk.en: This area is a flat town on black-clay soils where storm water ponds in low streets and seasonal streams flood quickly, and water runs short in the dry season.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni mji tambarare kwenye udongo mweusi wa mfinyanzi ambapo maji ya dhoruba hutuama kwenye mitaa ya chini na vijito vya msimu hufurika haraka, na maji hupungua wakati wa kiangazi.

advice.en: For those living and trading here, it helps to keep drains and stream reserves clear, build on raised foundations and store water safely. What raises the risk in both wet and dry months: building inside the stream reserves, filling the drains with waste, and leaving water standing in open containers after the rains. Know the higher street or school ground your household will move to when storm water ponds in the low streets, and agree early where water will come from when the town supply runs short in the dry season. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kufanya biashara hapa, ni vyema kuweka mitaro na hifadhi za vijito wazi, kujenga kwa misingi iliyoinuliwa na kuhifadhi maji kwa usalama. Kinachoongeza hatari katika miezi ya mvua na ya kiangazi: kujenga ndani ya hifadhi za vijito, kujaza mitaro taka, na kuacha maji yakituama kwenye vyombo wazi baada ya mvua. Fahamu mtaa wa juu au uwanja wa shule ambao kaya yako itahamia maji ya dhoruba yanapotuama mitaa ya chini, na kubalianeni mapema maji yatatoka wapi maji ya mji yanapopungua wakati wa kiangazi. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C120.name: Kahama Town Council
C120.documented: drought, gold-pit collapse, flash floods, and strong winds

area.en: Kahama Town: mining town and highway
area.sw: Mji wa Kahama: mji wa madini na barabara kuu

risk.en: This area is a fast-growing mining and trading town on the Isaka–Rwanda corridor where unplanned settlements flood and heavy traffic brings accident and fire risk.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni mji wa madini na biashara unaokua kwa kasi kwenye ukanda wa Isaka–Rwanda ambapo makazi holela hufurika na magari mengi huleta hatari ya ajali na moto.

advice.en: For those living and trading here, it helps to build outside stream and road reserves, keep drains open and keep fire extinguishers at fuel stations and markets. What raises the risk: building inside the stream and road reserves, storing fuel in homes and shops, running unlicensed wiring in crowded settlements and walking or trading on the highway edge. Know the higher ground away from the stream that your household will move to when storm water rises, and the open ground away from the fuel stations that traders will move to if a fuel fire or tanker crash happens; clear it at once when told. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kufanya biashara hapa, ni vyema kujenga nje ya hifadhi za vijito na barabara, kuweka mitaro wazi na kuweka vizimamoto kwenye vituo vya mafuta na masoko. Kinachoongeza hatari: kujenga ndani ya hifadhi za vijito na barabara, kuhifadhi mafuta majumbani na madukani, kutumia nyaya za umeme zisizo rasmi kwenye makazi yaliyosongamana na kutembea au kufanya biashara ukingoni mwa barabara kuu. Fahamu eneo la juu mbali na kijito ambalo kaya yako itahamia maji ya dhoruba yanapopanda, na uwanja wazi mbali na vituo vya mafuta ambao wafanyabiashara watahamia moto wa mafuta au ajali ya lori la mafuta ikitokea; ondokeni mara moja mnapoambiwa. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C122.name: Kishapu District Council
C122.documented: drought, mining accidents, strong winds, and flash floods

area.en: Kishapu: dry plains, Mwadui and grazing land
area.sw: Kishapu: tambarare kame, Mwadui na maeneo ya malisho

risk.en: This area has dry, flat plains where droughts kill crops and livestock, clay soils waterlog in heavy rains and the Mwadui diamond mine and tailings lie nearby.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina tambarare kame ambapo ukame huua mazao na mifugo, udongo wa mfinyanzi hujaa maji wakati wa mvua kubwa na mgodi wa almasi wa Mwadui na mabwawa ya tope la mgodi yako karibu.

advice.en: For those farming and herding here, it helps to plant drought-tolerant crops, follow agreed grazing routes and keep homes away from tailings and mine pits. What raises the loss and to the danger: relying on maize alone, keeping more animals than the dry-season pasture can carry, driving herds onto cropped fields, and settling or grazing near the tailings and pits. Agree early, between farmers and herders, where the herds will water and the families will find food in a failed season, and move before the animals weaken; in heavy rain, keep off the waterlogged black soils and away from the pit edges. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaolima na kufuga hapa, ni vyema kupanda mazao yanayostahimili ukame, kufuata njia za malisho zilizokubaliwa na kujenga mbali na mabwawa ya tope na mashimo ya migodi. Kinachoongeza hasara na hatari: kutegemea mahindi pekee, kuweka mifugo mingi kuliko malisho ya kiangazi yanavyoweza kubeba, kuingiza mifugo kwenye mashamba yenye mazao, na kukaa au kuchunga karibu na mabwawa ya tope na mashimo. Kubalianeni mapema, wakulima na wafugaji, mifugo itanyweshwa wapi na familia zitapata wapi chakula msimu ukikosekana, na hamieni kabla mifugo haijadhoofika; wakati wa mvua kubwa, epukeni udongo mweusi uliojaa maji na kingo za mashimo. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C121.name: Msalala District Council
C121.documented: drought, gold-pit collapse, flash floods, and strong winds

risk.en: This area has large and artisanal gold mines where pits collapse when saturated and mercury and tailings pollute water.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina migodi mikubwa na midogo ya dhahabu ambapo mashimo hubomoka yanapojaa maji na zebaki na tope la mgodi huchafua maji.

advice.en: For those mining and living here, it helps to support pit walls, fence or backfill old pits and use safe drinking water sources away from mining run-off. What raises the risk: digging pits without timbering, working them while rain is falling, washing ore with mercury in the streams people drink from and building homes at the lip of old pits. Keep everyone out of the pits once rain starts and know the firm ground away from them that your household will move to; if people fall sick after drinking from a stream below the workings, change the water source and report it the same day. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaochimba na kuishi hapa, ni vyema kuimarisha kuta za mashimo, kuzungushia uzio au kufukia mashimo ya zamani na kutumia vyanzo salama vya maji mbali na maji ya migodi. Kinachoongeza hatari: kuchimba mashimo bila mihimili, kuyafanyia kazi mvua ikinyesha, kuosha mawe ya madini kwa zebaki kwenye vijito ambavyo watu hunywa na kujenga nyumba kando ya mashimo ya zamani. Mtoe kila mtu mashimoni mara mvua inapoanza na fahamu eneo imara mbali nayo ambalo kaya yako itahamia; watu wakiugua baada ya kunywa maji ya kijito chini ya machimbo, badilisheni chanzo cha maji na ripoti siku hiyo hiyo. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C123.name: Shinyanga District Council
C123.documented: drought, strong winds, wildfire, and flash floods

area.en: Shinyanga DC: mbuga plains and farmland

risk.en: This area has mbuga plains where heavy rain waterlogs fields and cuts rural roads, and dry spells and drought reduce harvests and pasture.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina mbuga ambapo mvua kubwa hujaza maji mashamba na kukata barabara za vijijini, na vipindi vya ukavu na ukame hupunguza mavuno na malisho.

advice.en: For those farming here, it helps to build on higher ground, open field drains and keep household food and seed reserves. What raises the loss in both wet and dry years: building homes and stores on the low mbuga, relying on one crop, selling the whole harvest at once and cutting the remaining trees for charcoal when money is short. Know the raised ground and the dry route to it that your village will use when the mbuga floods, and agree early, as a household and a village, where food will come from in a failed season; act before the stores are empty. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaolima hapa, ni vyema kujenga sehemu za miinuko, kufungua mifereji ya mashamba na kuweka akiba ya chakula na mbegu ya kaya. Kinachoongeza hasara katika miaka ya mvua nyingi na ya ukame: kujenga nyumba na maghala kwenye mbuga za chini, kutegemea zao moja, kuuza mavuno yote kwa mara moja na kukata miti iliyobaki kwa mkaa pesa zinapopungua. Fahamu eneo lililoinuka na njia kavu ya kufika huko ambayo kijiji chenu kitatumia mbuga inapofurika, na kubalianeni mapema, kama kaya na kijiji, chakula kitatoka wapi msimu ukikosekana; chukueni hatua kabla akiba haijaisha. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C119.name: Ushetu District Council
C119.documented: drought, mining accidents, strong winds, and flash floods

area.sw: Ushetu: mashamba ya miombo na tumbaku

risk.en: This area has miombo farmland and tobacco growing where forest clearing and dry-season fires degrade land, and rains cut remote roads.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina mashamba ya miombo na kilimo cha tumbaku ambapo ukataji wa misitu na moto wa kiangazi huharibu ardhi, na mvua hukata barabara za mbali.

advice.en: For those farming here, it helps to plant woodlots, burn only under control and keep food and medicine reserves before the rains. What raises the risk: clearing new miombo for tobacco every season, burning late in the dry season on windy days, and letting village food and medicine stocks run out before the roads close. Know the cleared open ground your household will move to if a bush fire comes towards the houses, and move when smoke is seen on the forest edge; restock before the rains, because the road may be cut for weeks. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaolima hapa, ni vyema kupanda mashamba ya miti, kuchoma kwa udhibiti tu na kuweka akiba ya chakula na dawa kabla ya mvua. Kinachoongeza hatari: kufyeka miombo mipya kwa tumbaku kila msimu, kuchoma mwishoni mwa kiangazi siku za upepo, na kuacha akiba za chakula na dawa za kijiji ziishe kabla barabara hazijafungwa. Fahamu uwanja wazi uliosafishwa ambao kaya yako itahamia moto wa porini ukielekea nyumbani, na ondokeni moshi ukionekana mpakani mwa msitu; jazeni akiba kabla ya mvua, kwa sababu barabara inaweza kufungwa kwa wiki. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.
